class.name: NNSTExpressionGuard
class.brief_description: Guard that gates a transition using a Godot [Expression] over blackboard values.
class.description: Evaluates [member expression] against the state tree's blackboard keys (set via [method NNSTRoot.set_expression_property] or [member NNSTRoot.initial_expression_properties]), allowing the transition when it returns [code]true[/code]. Use for flexible data-driven conditions like [code]health < 25 and not is_invulnerable[/code] without writing a custom guard script.

members.member: Boolean [Expression] referencing keys on the state tree's blackboard (for example, [code]ammo == 0[/code]). Missing keys evaluate as [code]null[/code].
